cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
mkdir -p backup_snap; cp classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py backup_snap/
for f in classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py; do
  curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f" -o /tmp/new_$f || { echo FETCH_FAIL $f; exit 1; }
  python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('/tmp/new_$f',encoding='utf-8').read())" || { echo PARSE_FAIL $f; exit 1; }
done
for f in classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py; do cp /tmp/new_$f $f; done; chown tbot:tbot classic_*.py
systemctl restart classicbot
T0=$(date +%s)
for i in $(seq 1 24); do sleep 5; L=$(curl -s -m 10 localhost:8091/api/runs | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('1' if d.get('loading') else '0')" 2>/dev/null); [ "$L" = "0" ] && break; done
echo готово_через=$(( $(date +%s)-T0 ))с loading=$L
for k in 1 2 3; do S=$(date +%s.%N); curl -s -m 20 localhost:8091/api/runs -o /tmp/s.json; E=$(date +%s.%N); echo "GET $k: $(python3 -c "print(round($E-$S,2))") с"; done
sleep 30
S=$(date +%s.%N); curl -s -m 20 localhost:8091/ -o /dev/null; E=$(date +%s.%N); echo "страница во время пересчёта: $(python3 -c "print(round($E-$S,2))") с"
python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('/tmp/s.json'));print('runs',len(d['runs']),[ (k,d['accounts'][k]['account']['equity'],d['accounts'][k]['signals']['n']) for k in ('me','bot','both')])"
journalctl -u classicbot --since '3 min ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -c Traceback
